legal.verdict.raw_value: The Tribunal does not accept the claim that he will be returning to China as a known Falun Gong practitioner and faces harm from the Chinese authorities for that reason. Consequently it is not satisfied that he has a well-founded fear of persecution for reasons of his being perceived to be a Falun Gong practitioner by the authorities.
